name: Manipulate Probability
body:
Through sheer will, you can make yourself less likely to fail at one task.

Prerequisite: Xax, Wis 13

Benefit: A number of times per day equal to your Wisdom bonus, you may roll 5d4 in the place of a d20 for a skill check, saving throw, or roll to hit.
